# MerchantCanvas

> MerchantCanvas builds focused Shopify apps. MultiTier Discounts is live; B2B Quote Approvals is coming soon.

Contact: support@merchantcanvas.com. Prices are in USD. Features vary by plan; use the public product pages for current scope and eligibility. An App Store click is an install intent, not proof of a completed installation.

MultiTier Discounts pricing:

- Free: $0 forever; 2 active campaigns.
- Starter: $5.99/month or $59.90/year; 14-day free trial; 10 active campaigns.
- Pro: $12.99/month or $129.90/year; 14-day free trial; unlimited active campaigns.
- Plus: $24.99/month or $249.90/year; 14-day free trial; unlimited active campaigns. Eligible Shopify Plus stores only.
- The public Shopify App Store listing shows Free, Starter, Pro, and Plus. Plus is available only to eligible Shopify Plus stores and is presented separately on this site from the three standard plans.

MerchantCanvas does not publish review ratings, merchant counts, or guaranteed outcomes without verified public evidence. This convenience summary does not replace the canonical public pages, robots.txt, structured data, or sitemap.

## Products

- [MerchantCanvas](https://merchantcanvas.com/): Portfolio overview and live-product next steps.
- [MultiTier Discounts](https://merchantcanvas.com/apps/multitier-discounts): Live Shopify app for quantity breaks, cart-value rewards, Buy X Get Y, gifts, eligibility rules, storefront widgets, and Shopify Functions checkout discounts. Pricing, limitations, real screenshots, and FAQs are on this page.
- [Install MultiTier Discounts](https://apps.shopify.com/multitier-discounts): Official Shopify App Store listing and installation path.
- [B2B Quote Approvals](https://merchantcanvas.com/apps/b2b-quote-approvals): Coming-soon Shopify quote-approval workflow. No public installation URL.
